subject.title: Native Anthropic path: replaying historical `thinking` blocks bricks long tool-use threads (`Invalid signature in thinking block` 400)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the focused native Anthropic policy from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383: drop completed-turn thinking for non-fable5 thinking-enabled requests while preserving active tool-use and fable5 replay?
rationale: The issue is a confirmed bug, but the repair changes a provider replay/cache compatibility boundary that current code deliberately preserves for newer Claude models.

options.title: Accept focused native policy
options.body: Land the proof-positive two-builder fix and keep broader Bedrock, compaction, and recovery variants on their own sibling items.

options.title: Require broader replay sanitizer
options.body: Reject the provider-builder-only scope and ask for a session-history-level policy that handles more signed-thinking variants together.

options.title: Hold for fresh live proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until maintainers get exact-head redacted Anthropic 400-to-200 proof on the latest main.

recommendation.title: Accept focused native policy
recommendation.body: Land the proof-positive two-builder fix and keep broader Bedrock, compaction, and recovery variants on their own sibling items.
